notes: Synthetic: built field for field from the integration's own request construction, not captured off the wire. A live capture is owed (docs/testing.md, check 149).
The app is the bundle identifier; the name a person reads is only in tool_params_display.
persist is ['session', 'always'] when the integration's policy allows persistent approval, else ['session'].

The integration reads the answer's _meta.persist, and its own telemetry counts an accept without it as a session grant. node_repl keeps session grants per thread under CODEX_HOME/computer-use/sessions and always grants in its ComputerUseAppApprovals.json.
A later request the integration already holds a grant for is answered by the integration itself, with content.source 'computer-use-persisted-state', and never reaches Acorn.
